data.one_liner: Generates a MaterialColor palette from a single HEX color.
data.what_it_does: The package provides a function that takes a HEX color and creates a MaterialColor with the required swatch values. It enables using any custom color as a primarySwatch in ThemeData.
use_when: You need a custom primarySwatch without manually defining all shades
You want quick theming based on brand colors
avoid_when: You require advanced color manipulation or accessibility checks
You need a full design system beyond simple color swatches
weaknesses: Limited to generating basic MaterialColor palettes
No customization of shade generation algorithm
